name: Teslina pošiljka - Kod proroka
overview: The protagonist, Novak Ivanović, is thrust into a thriller-like plot following the death of his colleague Robert, who did not live long enough to reveal the reason for their scheduled meeting. He suddenly finds himself in a world of secret archives, clandestine societies, family legacies, fragmentary documents, and an unusual shipment from Tesla that has the power to change the world.
